messages:
Anya (CSM): Heads up — SummitHealth's daily token usage dropped ~63% week-over-week after they changed the procurement contact. New stakeholder (Erin, Dir of BI) is running a competitive eval. They also reported higher latency on long-chat flows. Tagging Sam for renewal visibility. TL;DR: usage drop + stakeholder change + competitive eval.

Sam (AM): Thanks Anya. When's their renewal? Any notes on committed capacity or discounts?

Anya (CSM): Renewal: 2026-06-30. Commitment: 500k token/mo on Dedicated plan (not yet active). No formal discount. Contact: erin.keller@summithealth (Dir BI).

Lee (Sales): Competitive eval — which vendors?

Anya (CSM): They're testing AcmeAI and CloudGen side-by-side. They ran a short perf sweep and saw higher p50 latency for our chat model on sessions >1024 tokens. Metrics snippet below.

Anya (CSM): ```
week: 2026-03-14 -> 2026-03-20
avg tokens/day: 45k -> 16k
sessions >1024 tokens p50 latency: 420ms -> 720ms
errors (timeout 10s): 0 -> 4
```

Raj (Solutions Eng): Can you share a convo id or sample request so I can run traces? Also want to confirm model variant and whether fallback to a quantized model occurred.

Anya (CSM): Convo id: summit-20260318-9f2. Prompts are long clinical-note synth + multi-turn summarization. No fallback configured; they're on open/gpt-16k-raw (unquantized hosted).

Raj (Solutions Eng): Got it. I'll triage kernel selection, batching, and KV cache behavior. Quick ask: any visible spikes in queue depth or instance fallback in logs?

Anya (CSM): Queue depth spiked around the longer sessions; I can share a secure link to traces.

Sam (AM): Proposed next steps: 1) Raj triages perf (48h), 2) Anya schedules business+procurement call with Erin, 3) Product to assemble competitor latency comparison, 4) Sales to propose a short Dedicated perf pilot. @Lee can you confirm pilot terms?

Lee (Sales): We can offer a 2-week Dedicated perf pilot (low-cost, limited capacity) — need legal & finance sign-off for SOW. I can draft SOW this week.

onboard-bot: ticket CS-1489 created for "SummitHealth renewal risk — perf & stakeholder change" assigned to Raj.

Anya (CSM): I'll send a calendar invite for 2026-03-25 09:00 PT for a triage + business review. @Sam @Lee please join. I'll prepare enablement deck and upload traces.

Sam (AM): Noted. Flagging finance that revenue projection may dip if they pause usage; will loop in renewals.

Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll share initial findings and traces by EOD tomorrow. If kernel selection is the issue, propose testing q4 quantized variant + an adjusted batch_policy for long contexts.

Anya (CSM): Thanks — ping me if you need raw trace access, I'll grant to the team.

Lee (Sales): :thumbsup:
